title: Renewable Energy Sources
text: Renewable energy sources are those replenished naturally on human timescales, including solar, wind, hydropower, biomass, geothermal, and tidal energy. Solar photovoltaic and wind energy have been the fastest-growing energy sources, with costs falling dramatically over the past decade. Wind energy now provides about 7% of global electricity, and solar photovoltaics about 4%. Hydropower remains the largest renewable electricity source, providing about 16% of global electricity. Denmark generated over 50% of its electricity from wind in 2023. The transition to renewable energy is central to efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and limit climate change.
